title_en: Three Typical Cases from the Supreme People's Court on Crimes of Trafficking Women and Children
keywords_en: intentional homicide; theft; cases concerning crimes of abducting and trafficking women and children
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Three Typical Cases of Crimes of Trafficking Women and Children

Case 1

Lyu Jincheng Intentional Homicide, Child Trafficking; Huang Gaosheng Child Trafficking Case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Lyu Jincheng, male, Han Chinese, born on July 17, 1985, farmer.

Defendant Huang Gaosheng, male, Han Chinese, born on September 5, 1965, farmer. On April 6, 1988, he was sentenced to three years and six months' imprisonment for the crime of theft, and was released upon completion of his sentence on January 7, 1991.

Defendants Lyu Jincheng and Huang Gaosheng, for the purpose of trafficking children for profit, conspired to steal the male infant Huang, who was the son of the victim Huang Jinhua (deceased, aged 26) and was less than eight months old at the time, and agreed to use violence to seize the infant if discovered. Thereafter, the two conducted reconnaissance for this purpose, and prepared tools for prying open doors and weapons including a dagger and beer bottles for committing violence. Huang Gaosheng contacted a buyer through Pan Rongguo (a co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced). At approximately 3:00 a.m. on September 2, 2008, Huang Gaosheng drove a motorcycle carrying Lyu Jincheng to the outside of the home of Huang Jinhua in Luoxi Village, Luodong Town, Nan'an City, Fujian Province. Huang Gaosheng waited outside the house, while Lyu Jincheng sneaked into the bedroom of Huang Jinhua and the infant Huang. Huang Jinhua and Huang Jinhua's grandmother Dai Shuzhi (deceased, aged 75) discovered them and cried out for help. In order to subdue the victims and seize the infant, Lyu Jincheng stabbed Huang Jinhua and Dai Shuzhi multiple times with the dagger, causing Huang Jinhua to die from hemorrhagic shock, and Dai Shuzhi to die from hemorrhagic shock and cerebral dysfunction due to severance of the right internal jugular vein despite emergency medical treatment. Thereafter, the two defendants seized the male infant Huang and sold him for RMB 37,000.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendants Lyu Jincheng and Huang Gaosheng, for the purpose of selling, kidnapped an infant, and their actions both constituted the crime of child trafficking; when Lyu Jincheng was committing the kidnapping, he stabbed with a knife, causing the deaths of two victims, and his action constituted the crime of intentional homicide, and the crime was extremely serious, and he should be punished for multiple crimes concurrently. Huang Gaosheng committed the crime of child trafficking resulting in the deaths of two persons, and the crime was extremely serious, but he did not conspire with Lyu Jincheng to commit murder, nor did he specifically carry out the killing. Accordingly, in accordance with law, Huang Gaosheng was sentenced to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, for the crime of child trafficking; defendant Lyu Jincheng was sentenced to death for the crime of intentional homicide, and to life imprisonment for the crime of child trafficking. Upon review and approval by the Supreme People's Court, the criminal Lyu Jincheng was executed in accordance with law recently.

Case 2

He Cong Child Trafficking Case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant He Cong, male, Han Chinese, born on February 13, 1974, farmer.

From March 2006 to July 2007, defendant He Cong, after conspiring with Xiang Liuxian (a co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced), successively stole and abducted 12 children in areas including the urban district of Guiyang City, Guizhou Province and the Liupanshui City railway station, took them to areas including Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold them to local villagers through Yang Xumei, Luo Yunfeng, and Zhao Wencai (all co-defendants in the same case, already sentenced). The specific facts are as follows:

At approximately 5:00 p.m. on March 31, 2006, defendant He Cong, near the No. 368 Hospital in Longdongbao, Nanming District, Guiyang City, Guizhou Province, took away a female child Zhao (then aged 4) who was playing. Thereafter, He Cong, together with Xiang Liuxian and Du Xiaohong (at large), took Zhao to Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold her to a local villager through Yang Xumei.

Around May 2006, defendant He Cong, together with Xiang Liuxian, directed another person near Longdongbao, Nanming District, Guiyang City, to take away a female child aged about 2 (biological parents not found, currently adopted by Guiyang Children's Welfare Home). Thereafter, together with Xiang Liuxian, he took the female child to Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold her to a local villager through Luo Yunfeng.

At approximately 2:00 p.m. on June 8, 2006, defendant He Cong directed another person near the Pengjiawan Vegetable Market, Nanming District, Guiyang City, to abduct a male child Peng (then aged 7) who was playing. Thereafter, together with Xiang Liuxian, he took Peng to Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold him to a local villager through Yang Xumei.

At approximately 7:00 p.m. on July 25, 2006, defendant He Cong directed another person near the intersection of Bishan Village, Nanming District, Guiyang City, to abduct a male child Luo (then aged 4) who was playing. Thereafter, together with Xiang Liuxian, he took Luo to Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold him to a local villager through Yang Xumei.

Around August 2006, defendant He Cong directed another person in Guiyang City to take away a male child aged about 2 (biological parents not found, currently adopted by Guiyang Children's Welfare Home). Thereafter, together with Xiang Liuxian, he took the male child to Huaxian County, Henan Province, and sold him to a local villager through Luo Yunfeng.

On a certain day in August 2006, defendant He Cong lured a street child "Yi Long" (male, then aged about 10, currently adopted by Guiyang Welfare Home) from the Liupanshui City railway station to Guiyang City, and Xiang Liuxian took "Yi Long" to Huaxian County, Henan Province and sold him to a local villager.

At approximately 5:00 p.m. on September 2, 2006, defendant He Cong, together with Xiang Liuxian, near the Pengjiawan Carton Factory, Nanming District, Guiyang City, took away a male child Liu (then aged 4) who was playing. Thereafter, Xiang Liuxian took Liu to Huaxian County, Henan Province and sold him to a local villager through Luo Yunfeng.

At approximately 1:00 p.m. on September 27, 2006, defendant He Cong, together with Xiang Liuxian, near Pengjiawan, Nanming District, Guiyang City, abducted a male child Yang (then aged 9) who was playing. Thereafter, the two took Yang to Xunxian County, Henan Province, and through Zhao Wencai's contact, Xiang Liuxian sold Yang to a local villager.

At approximately 9:00 p.m. on April 3, 2007, defendant He Cong, through another person, near Dali Road, Nanming District, Guiyang City, abducted a male child Chen (then aged 6) who was playing near his home. Thereafter, Xiang Liuxian took Chen to Xunxian County, Henan Province and sold him to a local villager.

At approximately 5:00 p.m. on June 5, 2007, defendant He Cong directed another person near the Pengjiawan Vegetable Market, Nanming District, Guiyang City, to take away a female child Luo (then aged 3) who was playing. Xiang Liuxian took Luo to Huaxian County, Henan Province and sold her to a local villager through Yang Xumei.

At approximately 11:00 a.m. on June 8, 2007, defendant He Cong directed another person near the intersection of Maiganchong, Nanming District, Guiyang City, to abduct a male child Yang (then aged 5) who was playing near his home. Thereafter, Xiang Liuxian took Yang to Huaxian County, Henan Province and sold him to a local villager through Zhao Wencai.

At approximately 3:00 p.m. on July 21, 2007, defendant He Cong directed another person near Qianling Lake, Qianling Park, Guiyang City, to abduct a male child Wang (then aged 6) who was playing, intending to traffick Wang to Henan Province. On July 22 of the same year, He Cong, together with Xiang Liuxian, was taking Wang and was arrested on the spot at Kaili Railway Station in Guizhou Province.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant He Cong, together with others, stole and abducted children and sold them, and his actions constituted the crime of child trafficking. He Cong conspired with others to traffick children, directly stole and abducted 2 children, and directed others to abduct 10 children and took them to other places to sell for profit. He played a principal role in the joint crime, was a principal offender, and should be punished for all the crimes in which he participated. He Cong trafficked 12 children within a period of one year and four months, including 7 young children, the circumstances of the crime were particularly vile, the social harm was great, and the crime was extremely serious. Accordingly, in accordance with law, defendant He Cong was sentenced to death for the crime of child trafficking, and the sentence was approved. The criminal He Cong was executed in accordance with law recently.

Case 3

Li Zhongmei Purchasing an Abducted Child Case

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Li Zhongmei, female, Han Chinese, born on March 6, 1969, farmer.

From October 2007 to early 2009, An Tingzao, Xie Changfu, Meng Fancheng, Ma Yinxiu, Meng Lingmin, and Kan Zhongqin (all already sentenced) jointly trafficked 13 children in areas including Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province and Linyi City, Shandong Province. Defendant Li Zhongmei had already given birth to two daughters. After learning that An Tingzao was a child trafficker, she requested him to help purchase a male infant for "adoption". In January 2008, through An Tingzao's contact, Li Zhongmei accompanied An Tingzao to Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province and purchased an abducted male infant. Li Zhongmei paid An Tingzao RMB 36,000. In October 2008, through Li Zhongmei's introduction, Wang Xinzhi (a co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced) purchased an abducted male infant from An Tingzao and Xie Changfu.

(II) Judgment

The court held that defendant Li Zhongmei, knowing that it was an abducted child, still purchased the child and assisted others in purchasing an abducted child, and her actions constituted the crime of purchasing an abducted child. In view of the fact that Li Zhongmei purchased the child for the purpose of private adoption, and that she had a good attitude in admitting guilt after being brought to justice, in accordance with law, she was sentenced to two years' imprisonment, suspended for three years.
